text: APPROVE: The extracted `TryBuildEntryMarker` returns null in exactly the cases where the original loop hit `continue`, and it builds the same `DebtMarker` otherwise. That leaves `ScanLines` with only a loop and one `if`, well under 15, and nothing in the diff should break the build. I could only review the diff, not build it, so the parameter types (`YamlLine[]`, `List<DisabledBlock>`) and `DebtMarker` being a reference type are assumptions.
